title: Apply modern gradient styling to dashboard

requirements.summary: Apply modern gradient backgrounds to FactorMarker cards, IntermittentFastingPanel, and NutritionPanel using OKLCH colors while preserving the DNA helix background
acceptanceCriteria: FactorMarker cards display modern gradient backgrounds instead of solid colors
IntermittentFastingPanel uses gradient styling for visual appeal
DNA helix background (AnimatedHelixBackground.tsx) remains completely unchanged
Gradients use colors from the existing OKLCH color system (golden/amber, sage/earth tones)
Dark mode gradients remain visually cohesive with the DNA helix theme

file_operations.description: Replace solid background colors with modern gradient backgrounds using OKLCH golden/amber and sage tones from the existing color system. Apply gradients to card backgrounds while maintaining hover effects, selection states, and visual connection indicators. Ensure gradient directions and color stops create depth without overwhelming the helix connection lines.

Apply gradient styling to the panel background and visual elements such as the timer display, progress indicators, and metric cards. Use subtle gradients that complement the existing golden/amber accent colors and maintain readability of fasting status, protocol labels, and metrics. Ensure gradients work in both light and dark modes.

Incorporate gradient design elements into the panel background, progress bars, and metric display sections (BMI, protein, vegetables). Apply gradients that enhance visual hierarchy while preserving the readability of nutrition data, form inputs, and guidance messages. Use sage/earth tones for health-related metrics and golden accents for highlights.

Add reusable CSS custom properties or utility classes for gradient definitions using existing OKLCH color variables. Define gradient presets for cards, panels, and interactive elements that can be referenced throughout the dashboard. Ensure gradient definitions work seamlessly in both light and dark mode contexts without modifying existing color variables.

requirements.summary: Ensure gradient styling maintains readability and accessibility with sufficient contrast for all interactive elements and text overlays
acceptanceCriteria: Text remains readable against gradient backgrounds in both light and dark modes
Interactive elements (buttons, inputs) maintain clear visual states on gradient backgrounds
Hover and active states work effectively with gradient styling

file_operations.description: Verify text contrast ratios on gradient backgrounds and add semi-transparent overlays or text shadows if needed to ensure factor names and descriptions remain readable. Test and adjust hover state gradients to provide clear visual feedback. Ensure selection state remains visually distinct with gradient backgrounds.

Ensure timer text, protocol labels, and metric values maintain sufficient contrast against gradient backgrounds. Add text shadows or adjust gradient opacity where necessary. Verify that buttons and interactive elements (save/cancel in settings) have clear visual states on gradient surfaces.

Verify that form inputs, labels, BMI values, protein targets, and progress percentages remain readable on gradient backgrounds. Ensure input fields have clear focus states and that save button states are visually distinct. Test guidance messages for readability against panel gradients in both theme modes.
